# One entry that sells shares and spends the dollars they fetched, in a single
# transaction, with one split standing as the difference.
#
# It is refused. The entry disposes of two cost bases of two different kinds — the
# shares, and the US dollars — so it realizes a difference on each, and the one
# `$residual$` split between them cannot be both. A balance sheet states a gain
# on currency apart from a gain on shares, as a filer's return does, so counting
# the single figure as either would state the other as nothing, and dividing it
# would be `import` writing a split the file never did.
#
# Written as two entries it is unambiguous: the shares sold for what they
# fetched, and then those dollars spent.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_entry_disposing_of_two_kinds_at_once_is_refused.py.
2030-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2030-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2030-01-01 commodity USD_TECH
	mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
	fullname: "A company whose shares are priced in US dollars"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000

	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"

2030-01-08 * "Buy 50 shares at 40.00 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Shares 50.0000 USD_TECH
		guid: "c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c30002"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
		share_price: "52"
		value: "2600.00"
	Assets:USD Bank -2000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-2600.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c30001"

# Both kinds disposed of in one entry again, and this one is imported. No split of
# it stands as the difference — every figure is stated outright — so there is
# nothing ambiguous to divide and nothing for the refusal to protect. What it
# refuses is one split being asked to be two differences, not the two disposals
# sharing an entry.
2030-05-31 * "Sell 10 shares and spend 100.00 USD, every figure stated"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Shares -10.0000 USD_TECH
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
		share_price: "52"
		value: "-520.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c30002"
	Assets:USD Bank -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-130.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c30001"
	Assets:CAD Bank 650.00 CAD

# The refused entry: 20 shares and 500.00 US dollars disposed of, in one
# transaction, with a single split standing as the difference on both.
2030-06-30 * "Sell 20 shares and spend 500.00 USD in one entry"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Shares -20.0000 USD_TECH
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD_TECH"
		share_price: "52"
		value: "-1040.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c30002"
	Assets:USD Bank -500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-650.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c30001"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1800.00 CAD
	Income:Realized Gains $residual$ CAD
